sections.name: Why Yawning Is Contagious
lines: You're probably going to yawn watching this.
A yawn is a huge stretch of your jaw, a deep breath in, and a quick breath out.
One leading idea is that it helps cool your brain, by pulling in cooler air and fresh blood.
People yawn less when the air is really hot, which fits that idea.
Yawns are also contagious. Seeing, hearing, or even reading about one can set you off.
Even dogs can catch yawns from their owners.
